title: 第28章
content:
“看7号场地，大岩蛇对战乘龙，虽然说克制关系大了一点，但总算有点看头了。”“哎呀，不是免费观看，谁来看宝宝杯呀，可惜在7号场地，不过也能看的清楚....”选手席位身后，一群观众讨论了起来，将目光纷纷放在了7号场地。不止是观众们，林枫的目光也一直放在7号场地。只是嘴角不由得抽了抽。解说人员这个话术，实在是太明显了好吧？先抬高对手的大岩蛇，然后再让乘龙击败大岩蛇....这样的衬托作用下，人们自然会对乘龙的印象更加深刻。“藤藤~！”怀中原本无聊的藤藤蛇，眼眸这会终于亮了起来。在这些所有宝可梦中...哪怕是那只火雉鸡，它也没放在眼里。但在这只乘龙的身上，它确实感受到了强敌的气息。“放心，迟早会撞上的。”林枫笑着摸了摸藤藤蛇的头，对于这样一只乘龙，他也确实挺好奇的。【精灵：乘龙】【性别：雄】【特性：储水】【资质：紫色】【个体值：HP（29）攻击（20）防御（19）特防（21）速度（18）】【实力：19级】【技能：叫声，水枪，唱歌，白雾，生命水滴，冰砾，冰冻光束，】【介绍：压抑能量痛苦的乘龙，因为压抑的太久，可能在突破能量束缚时，会产生能量满溢的现象。】【亲密度：0（它并不认识你）】【愉悦值：0（能量实在压不下了...）】不仅拥有紫色的资质，个体值在hp上也如此优秀。就是这个介绍...是因为早就能突破精英期，但是压抑住了吗？说实话，这种压抑能量突破对宝可梦而言不是好的行为。如果压的太久，会对宝可梦的身体，带来一种很胀痛的感觉。长久以往，甚至可能让宝可梦的成长上限降低。如果腾腾蛇在参加这场比赛之前，有了进化的自然而然现象，他会毫不犹豫的放弃这场比赛。

但对方明显没有这个觉悟。七号场地的对战已经开始了。而且过程很快，拿着薯片吃的矮胖男生，只是淡淡的下达了命令，“水枪。”强劲的水流，仿佛找到宣泄口一般，从乘龙的嘴里面喷吐而出。场地并不大，而且禁止了挖地洞绝招。庞大的体型，此刻仿佛成为了大岩蛇的禁锢，让它无处可逃。大岩蛇的训练家连忙下达了命令，让大岩蛇盘卷起来，尽量只让身体的侧面受到攻击。可好不容易找到发泄口的乘龙，一道水枪，完全没有停止的迹象，肆无忌惮的落在大岩蛇身上。本就存在克制关系，还有着能量压制。大岩蛇的目光很快就溃散起来，它的训练家意识到，这样下去，怕是被一招秒掉，连忙下达口令，“大岩蛇，落石。”强撑着身体上的疼痛，大岩蛇抬起头，凝聚岩石系能量，几块尖利的石头，朝着乘龙疾驰而去。可乘龙不管不顾，扛下几发落石的同时，水枪的劲力越发凶猛了。最终，大岩蛇还是顶不住这样高强度的水枪攻击，倒在了地上，发出沉闷的响声。“天呀，一招秒杀，培育如此优秀的大岩蛇，在乘龙的手下，竟然连一招都坚持不到。我们再看乘龙的训练家，他的表情如此淡定，好像早已经预料到了比赛结果....”上面的解说员，也适时的发出了调动情绪的解说。果然，在这样的情况下，整个观众席，上千名观众，纷纷将目光放在了乘龙的身上，发出了惊叹的声音。“这孩子，没想到其貌不扬啊，明明看起来没什么优点，培育出来的宝可梦竟然这么强。”“不出意外的话，这个第一名应该就是他的了吧？”“很强的乘龙！”....九组选手席上，“有点强度啊，腾腾蛇。”林枫感慨了一声。这只乘龙不只是实力和藤藤蛇相当，还有一个优点就是，临近突破，体内的能量很充沛。甚至可以说，释放能量对它本身来说就是一种放松。“藤藤...”藤藤蛇眨了眨眼睛，眼底的光芒越加旺盛。它才不怕对手强不强呢。越厉害，只会越调动它的好战心。“哦，对了，如果待会上场后，你有进化的欲望，不用压制。”林枫嘱咐了一句，

"Look at Court No. 7, Big Rock Snake vs. Chenglong. Although restraint has a little more to do with it, it's still interesting to watch." "Oh, it's not free to watch. Who comes to watch the Baby Cup? It's a pity that it's in Court No. 7, but you can still see it clearly..." Behind the players' seats, a group of spectators started discussing and focused their attention on Court No. 7.Not only the audience, but also Lin Feng's eyes were always on venue 7.But the corners of his mouth couldn't help but twitch.The commentator’s words are too obvious, right?First raise the opponent's Big Rock Snake, and then let Chenglong defeat the Big Rock Snake... With this kind of foil, people will naturally be more impressed by Chenglong."Teng Teng~!" The originally bored Teng Teng Snake in his arms finally lit up.Of all these Pokémon...even the Fire Pheasant, it didn't take it seriously.But on this Chenglong, it did feel the aura of a powerful enemy."Don't worry, we will bump into it sooner or later." Lin Feng smiled and touched the head of the vine snake. He was indeed quite curious about such a dragon.[Elf: Chenglong] [Gender: Male] [Characteristics: Water Storage] [Qualification: Purple] [Individual Value: HP (29) Attack (20) Defense (19) Special Defense (21) Speed ​​(18)] [Strength: Level 19] [Skills: Shout, Water Gun, Singing, White Mist, Life Water Drops, Boulders, Freeze Beam,] [Introduction: Chenglong who suppresses the pain of energy, may overflow with energy when he breaks through the energy constraints because he suppresses it for too long.] [Intimacy: 0 (it doesn’t know you)] [Pleasure value: 0 (The energy can’t be suppressed...)] Not only does it have purple qualifications, its individual value is also so good in terms of HP.This is the introduction... Is it because I have been able to break through the elite stage for a long time, but have I suppressed it?To be honest, this kind of suppressed energy breakthrough is not good behavior for a Pokémon.If you press it for too long, it will cause a very painful feeling to the Pokémon's body.Over time, the upper limit of Pokémon's growth may even be lowered.If Teng Teng Snake had a natural phenomenon of evolution before participating in this game, he would give up this game without hesitation.

But the other party obviously did not have this awareness.The battle on field seven has begun.And the process was very fast. The short and fat boy who was eating potato chips just gave the order lightly, "Water gun." The strong water flow spurted out from Chenglong's mouth as if it had found a vent.The venue is not large, and the trick of digging holes is prohibited.The huge size seemed to be a prison for the big rock snake at this moment, leaving it with nowhere to escape.The trainer of the big rock snake quickly issued an order to have the big rock snake coil up, trying to only allow the side of the body to be attacked.But Chenglong finally found the vent, and a water gun showed no sign of stopping, falling on the big rock snake unscrupulously.There is already a relationship of restraint and energy suppression.The Big Rock Snake's gaze quickly faded. Its trainer realized that if he continued like this, he might be killed instantly with one move, so he quickly gave the command, "Big Rock Snake, fall rocks." Holding on to the pain in his body, the Big Rock Snake raised his head, condensed the energy of the rock system, and galloped towards Chenglong with a few sharp stones.But Chenglong ignored it, and while he withstood a few falling rocks, the power of the water gun became more and more fierce.In the end, the big rock snake couldn't withstand such a high-intensity water gun attack and fell to the ground with a dull sound."Oh my god, you can kill such an excellent rock snake with one move. Under Chenglong's hands, he can't even hold on to a single move. Let's look at Chenglong's trainer again. His expression is so calm, as if he has already anticipated the outcome of the game..." The commentator above also made timely comments to arouse emotions.Sure enough, under such circumstances, the entire auditorium, thousands of spectators, all focused their attention on Chenglong and made a sound of exclamation."I didn't expect this kid to be humble in appearance. He obviously doesn't seem to have any merit, but the Pokémon he cultivated is so strong." "If nothing else, the first place should be his, right?" "A very strong dragon!"... On the contestant table of the ninth group, "You have a bit of strength, Teng Teng Snake." Lin Feng sighed with emotion.Not only is this Chenglong's strength comparable to that of the Vine Snake, but it also has the advantage that it has a lot of energy in its body as it approaches a breakthrough.It can even be said that releasing energy is a kind of relaxation in itself."Teng Teng..." Teng Teng Snake blinked his eyes, and the light in his eyes became more intense.It is not afraid of whether the opponent is strong or not.The more powerful it is, the more warlike it will be aroused."Oh, by the way, if you have the desire to evolve after you play later, you don't need to suppress it." Lin Feng warned,
